name: Cursed Legacy: Story of Faylinawa
storyline:
A mageblade named Jock is in turmoil, for he is the victim of a curse whose origin he does not know.
A renowned warrior named Shinky, however, cannot bring himself to abandon his best friend to such a grim fate.
According to a mysterious and ominous witch, this curse condemns him to two choices: remain forever with her in the Void to survive in a timeless, lifeless world, or return home to try to break the curse but become prey to all the demons who seek nothing but to end his life.

Refusing isolation at all costs, Jock decides to embark on a journey with Shinky in search of a healer.
But our heroes will soon learn that inheriting or confronting a curse demands a willingness to lose or take the life of someone dear to them.
summary:
Play as Jock, a mageblade struck by a dark curse. With his loyal companion Shinky, he sets out on a quest to find a healer who can break the evil consuming him.
Across perilous lands and against terrifying foes, they will discover that lifting the curse may demand a sacrifice greater than anything they had anticipated.
